name: tpl-existence-1-goal~p2
task: Grab the key first, then make your way to the goal.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The clause "Grab the key at least once." is redundant. The hard Precedence(has_key, at_goal) together with the hard Existence(at_goal) already guarantee that the key is grabbed before the goal is reached. Remove the redundant Existence(has_key) clause; keep Existence(at_goal) and Precedence(has_key, at_goal).

NO CHANGES NEEDED: The two clauses correctly encode that the agent must reach the goal (Existence(at_goal)) and that the goal cannot be reached before the key is grabbed (Precedence(has_key, at_goal)), which together enforce the task requirement that the key be obtained first and then the goal is reached.

texts: Reach the goal at least once.
The goal cannot be reached before the key is grabbed.
